method: Read-only reconciliation of plan, production code, existing test coverage, historical accepted results, and three actual unmodified UI screenshots. No new Xcode run or App launch.

T10.planCompletionCriterion: The same component has a consistent visual language across plugins.
T10.lightDarkAndIncreasedContrastSupport: Existing IslandDesignTokensTests cover six colors in both appearances and both contrast modes, at least 4.5 against the black island surface. No new system appearance switching performed.
T10.accessibilitySupport: Phase 3 user acceptance explicitly confirms Music VoiceOver and Volume Reduce Motion; shared Renderer semantic controls and reduced animation paths remain present. Not per-plugin exhaustive VoiceOver certification.

T11.remainingCriterion: Same Timer Activity visibly and smoothly progresses from minimal to compact and expanded without changing its instance or restarting its clock.
T11.suggestion: Preserve the two global Host window states; select a real minimal leaf on compact-tree fallback, place it in a camera-safe wing, then verify same-instance update to compact and Host expansion. No product toggle or plugin-owned dimensions needed.
T11.debugPanelCannotProveCurrentPomodoro: Existing DEBUG window owns a separate Manager and supplies no countdown resolver.

preparedImplementation.status: Directed regression passed; actual countdown and continuous physical UI acceptance still pending
preparedImplementation.behavior: Host selects accepted compact, otherwise accepted minimal, otherwise legacy compact summary. Minimal leaf is confined to the right wing outside the reserved center; same instance renderer keeps actions and countdown resolver.

validation.initialNewTestResult: failed: snapshot read before target Activity selected
validation.rootCause: The preview Music Activity remains current during normal Host debounce/minimum dwell. The test incorrectly captured that snapshot immediately after admission, then photographed before the target was selected. Later identity assertions compared the target to the original Music token.
validation.fix: Wait boundedly for the admitted target id/source to become current, assert both, and classify visible non-black high-alpha foreground. Retain glyph count >10, camera clearance >=8pt, same-token/createdAt, update/expansion assertions. No production change for this test correction.
validation.secondRootCause: The NSHostingView PNG visibly contains a white monochrome SF Symbol. An accent-only predicate incorrectly counted zero. A geometry test must detect non-black high-alpha foreground independently of color; dedicated token/Renderer tests retain color coverage.

originalControlledImage.source: Original unmodified successful XCTest attachment exported using xcresulttool
originalControlledImage.scope: Controlled NSHostingView of production IslandView; not an actual live countdown or a continuous physical island animation record

limits: Historical Release screenshot identity is preserved; it is not the current HEAD binary.
No new quantitative CPU, power, frame-rate, or all-device results.
Does not close T02, T08, or T11.
